_comment: Template config for run_barcode_pipeline.py. Copy this folder to run_configs/<your_run_name>/, edit config.json, then run: python run_barcode_pipeline.py run_configs/<your_run_name>/config.json. This is plain JSON (no comments allowed in the real file) -- see README.md in this folder for what each field means.
_stage_fastqs_comment: Normal run (barcode read is R1, the common case): just give {sample: path_to_R1_fastq.gz}, as below. For a run where the read orientation was swapped (barcode read is R2 for every sample in the run -- this never happens as a mix within one run), instead give every sample as {sample: {"src": path_to_R2_fastq.gz, "read": "R2"}}. See README.md.
